title: Completion of the macrostep schedule
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a,B\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a word of schedule symbols. Choose a base configuration on $x$, an input-head position $p$, an integer $b$, and a binary-budget tape $\beta$. Starting in the macrostep-check phase with unary head at $1$, unary tape containing $B$ markers, and guide head at $0$ over the guide of radius $3B$, after exactly $B(6(3B)+8)+1$ steps the machine is halted, with unary head at $B+1$; the input head, budget head and tape, unary tape, guide head and tape, and all clock tapes and output are otherwise as specified by the same setup configuration.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
a and B are natural numbers
base is a configuration on x
p is a valid input-head position
b is the binary-budget head position
replaced:
From a setup configuration in the macrostep-check phase with unary head at cell $1$
over the unary tape with $B$ markers and guide head at cell $0$ over the completed
guide of radius $3B$, exactly $B\,\bigl(6\,(3B) + 8\bigr) + 1$ steps execute one full
sweep per unary marker and reach the halted configuration with unary head at cell
$B+1$ and guide head at cell $0$; every tape, the budget head, and the input head are
unchanged.
